Application to the puzzle

This final hypothesis can be closed with a negative result. That doesn't rule it out SX/MSVC other dates and implementations generally RNG, length entropy, displacement RNG-flow, additional transformations or other HD-Ways. The study does not establish the program used by the puzzle maker.
